d: Anton Oilfield Services Group is a globally leading independent integrated oilfield technology services company, operating across major oil and gas production regions worldwide. The business covers oilfield technical services, oilfield management services, oil and gas development operations, natural gas utilization, AI-enabled solutions, and platform collaboration. Anton Group employs approximately 7,000 staff from over 30 countries and regions. Anton’s long-term goal is to become a world-leading green energy technical services company, growing together with its clients and talent to promote high-quality development in the energy industry.
Department: On Sync Energy Management Services Company
q: Bachelor's Degree or Diploma in Chemical, Process, Mechanical, Instrumentation, Electrical Engineering, or a related discipline.
For Bachelor's Degree holders: minimum 4 years of experience in Oil & Gas or process plant operations.
For Diploma holders: minimum 6 years of experience in Oil & Gas or process plant operations.
Strong experience in plant operations, shift supervision, and process optimization.
Experience with crude oil, gas processing, utilities, power and steam generation, or sulphur recovery operations is preferred.
Knowledge of computerized maintenance and plant management systems is an advantage.
Strong leadership, communication, decision-making, and problem-solving skills.
r: Lead and supervise shift teams to operate the plant safely, efficiently, and reliably.
Achieve production targets while maintaining required quality and HSE standards.
Monitor and control plant operations, including crude oil, sour gas, produced water, effluent water, and utility systems.
Operate and monitor process units such as Sulphur Recovery, Tail Gas, power generation, steam generation, and plant utilities.
Monitor operating parameters, identify abnormalities, and coordinate corrective actions to maintain stable operations.
Coordinate with maintenance and other functions to support reliable plant operation.

d: We are looking for a QA/QC Engineer with a strong background in application and digital project testing. The ideal candidate will have solid experience across functional and integration testing, with good exposure to AI, automation, and emerging technology projects.

The role will be responsible for ensuring the quality, reliability, and performance of digital solutions, including testing workflows, system integrations, APIs, automation processes, and AI-enabled use cases.
q: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
5+ years of QA/QC or Software Testing experience across application and digital projects.
Strong experience in functional, integration, regression, system, and UAT testing.
Good understanding of SDLC, STLC, defect management, and QA methodologies .
Experience testing APIs, integrations, workflows, and digital platforms.
Good exposure to AI, automation, or intelligent technology projects .
Ability to understand business requirements and translate them into comprehensive test scenarios.
Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments is preferred.
Good communication and stakeholder management skills.
Ability to work independently and coordinate effectively with technical and business teams.
r: Plan, design, and execute QA/QC activities across application and digital projects.
Develop and maintain test plans, test scenarios, test cases, and test scripts .
Perform functional, regression, integration, system, and end-to-end testing.
Test workflows, business processes, APIs, system integrations, and data flows .
Validate automation solutions and ensure automated workflows perform as expected.
Support testing of AI-enabled features and use cases , including AI-driven workflows and intelligent automation.
Validate AI outputs against defined business requirements and expected results.
Identify, document, track, and follow up on defects through resolution.
Work closely with developers, business analysts, project managers, and technical teams to investigate and resolve issues.
Perform root-cause analysis for recurring or critical defects.
Verify fixes and conduct regression testing before releases.
Support UAT activities and coordinate with business users to ensure requirements are properly validated.
Review requirements and specifications to identify potential quality and testing risks early in the project lifecycle.
Prepare QA status reports, defect reports, test execution reports, and quality metrics.
Ensure solutions meet agreed quality, functionality, security, and performance requirements .
Contribute to continuous improvement of QA processes, standards, and testing methodologies.
The candidate should have good exposure to testing technology-driven solutions, including:
AI-enabled applications and business use cases.
Validation of AI-generated outputs against expected business outcomes.
Data validation and consistency across integrated systems.
Identifying edge cases and potential failure scenarios in AI/automation solutions.
